# PromptMaster

> Android app that grades a prompt you wrote, names what is missing, and rewrites it. Package com.promptmaster.ai by ReedAI.

PromptMaster does not replace ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. It prepares the prompt those apps will run.

## What is free

- The first five grades.
- The score and a short explanation of the gaps (role, audience, constraints, format).
- The prompt of the day, which can be copied or sent without a grade.
- About 30 ready prompts with fill-in blanks, plus saved prompts and history.
- No API key is required to see a score. A key stays on the device and is only used if you want the answer to run inside the app.

## What Pro unlocks

- The full rewritten prompt.
- Copy.
- Send to ChatGPT: opens https://chatgpt.com/ with the rewrite filled in. You still send the message.
- Send to Claude: opens https://claude.ai/new with the rewrite filled in. You still send the message.
- Send to Gemini: copies the rewrite and opens https://gemini.google.com/app. Gemini does not accept a prefilled link.
- More: the Android share sheet, for Grok, Copilot, Messages, or any other app. If sharing is unavailable, the text is copied.
- If the link would be longer than about 1,500 characters, the text is copied and the chat opens empty so you can paste.
- Unlimited grades and no ads.
- Google Play shows the price before you pay. The site does not name a dollar amount.

## What this app does not do

- It does not run an on-device model.
- It does not claim a star rating or a review count on the site.
- It is not the other Android apps that also use the name PromptMaster.
